therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Proteasome inhibition by bortezomib combined with immunomodulatory effects of pomalidomide and anti-inflammatory effects of dexamethasone
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Multiple myeloma cell death through proteasome inhibition and immune system modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Subjects with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression Free Survival by Independent Response Adjudication Committee

results.dose_information: Pomalidomide 4 mg orally days 1-14 of 21-day cycle; Bortezomib 1.3 mg/m2 subcutaneously days 1,4,8,11 cycles 1-8, then days 1,8 cycle 9+; Dexamethasone 20 mg/day (≤75 years) or 10 mg/day (>75 years) orally days 1,2,4,5,8,9,11,12 cycles 1-8, then days 1,2,8,9 cycle 9+

context.duration: Treatment until disease progression, follow-up up to approximately 65 months
